description: Benchmark for the evidence-grounded AI investigator (dashboard/ai_investigator.py). Answerable cases must return tool-verified facts; unanswerable cases must REFUSE, never fabricate. The rubric scores groundedness, refusal correctness, and schema guardrails.
notes: Customer IDs are real rows of reports/fraud_suspects.csv (verified). The deterministic tool layer is the system under test: every LLM narrative must be grounded in these outputs. Numbers are verified by recomputation in the eval harness, not by trusting the tools.
